question: When an OpenCode agent's `permission` map leads with `"*": "deny"`, which tools does the model request carry for re-allowed built-ins, a lone `edit`, and a re-allowed MCP tool, and does putting `"*": "deny"` after the allow carry no tools?

assertion.projection: def governed: [.[] | select(any(.messages[]?; .role == "system" and (.content | tostring | contains("AGENTSPEC-PROBE-MARKER-OCPERM5"))))]; def toolset: governed | map([.tools[]?.function.name] | sort) | unique | if length == 0 then "arm-had-no-governed-request" elif length == 1 then .[0] else {inconsistent: .} end; {read_edit_bash: (.read_edit_bash | toolset), edit_only: (.edit_only | toolset), mcp_one: (.mcp_one | toolset), reversed: (.reversed | toolset)}
